$comment: Live runs of leaf commands against the real service. A leaf is 'validated' in data/catalog.json exactly while its latest run here passed; see READINESS.md and scripts/lib/readiness.mjs. Each run: leaf (catalog id), date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, the day the run finished), workflow (path under .github/workflows/), run (the GitHub Actions run URL), run_id / head_sha / event / head_branch (the run's id, commit, trigger and branch, as GET /repos/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id} reports them; scripts/verify-validation.mjs re-checks them against the API), environment (runner image and service versions), covered (which commands or lab steps ran), result (pass or fail). A validated leaf's run is also backed by its trimmed report committed as data/live/runs/<leaf>-<run_id>.json. Add a run by pull request, never from the workflow itself.
